_comment: IRL2FA power model. Currents at 3.0 V, 25 C. 'typ' from datasheet typicals, 'worst' from datasheet maxima. Used by hardware/power/power.py, hardware/tests/test_power.py and the browser simulator's battery meter. SPDX-License-Identifier: CERN-OHL-S-2.0

battery._usable_note: Renata CR2450N rates 540 mAh to 2.0 V at 7.5 kohm; pulsed e-paper loads and cold reduce it, so usable capacity is taken as the 540 mAh rating, not the 620 mAh nominal.

mcu_stop2.source: STM32U083 DS14548: Stop 2 without RTC 695 nA @ 1.8 V; scaled to 3 V

rtc_rv3032.source: RV-3032-C7 datasheet: 160 nA typ / 210 nA max @ 3 V

epd_switch_off.source: AO3401A IDSS 1 uA max at -30 V; nA at 3 V

mcu_mA.source: 52 uA/MHz at 16 MHz plus peripherals, mostly in WFI between polls

epd_mA.source: GDEY0213B74 typical operating current 3.5 mA @ 3 V

ir_mA.source: LED 18 mA at ~25 % duty while pairing + phototransistor load

awake._awake_note: About 10 s of reading/typing plus the firmware's 30 s idle timeout (IDLE_SLEEP_S_DEFAULT in firmware/core/app.c). Pressing left on the home menu sleeps at once.
